title: Ahohuru Bere a Ɛwɔ Anhwea Ase
intro: Wɔ Kur’aan abakɔsɛm mu no, onipa bi a ɔwɔ abotare kɛse hyiaa sɔhwɛ bi a ɛbɛbubu koma a ɛyɛ den sen biara. Woyii biribiara firii - ahonyadee, abusua, ne akwahosan. Nanso efi abasamtu a emu dɔ mu no, wobuaa ahobrɛase mu mpaebɔ bi wɔ ɔkwan a na wɔnhwɛ kwan koraa so. So wubetumi ahu ɔkra yi a n’asɛm a ɛfa sanba ho no ka wɔ mfe pii mu no?
clues: Wɔde sɔhwɛ bi a emu yɛ den araa ma wɔkae wɔ mfe no nyinaa mu sɔɔ me hwɛe.
Mehweree biribiara a ehia - m'ahonyade, me mma, ne m'akwahosan.
Ná akuru a ɛyɛ yaw akata me nipadua so, na na obiara kwati me.
Wɔ m’abasamtuo mu no, mefrɛɛ Allah, kaa sɛ Satan de ahokyere ne ayayadeɛ aka me.
Allah buaa me na ɔhyɛɛ me sɛ memfa me nan mmɔ asaase no.
Efi saa bea no ara mu no, asubura a nwini bi paee, na Allah san de m'abusua san bae na oboo won mmɔho mmienu sɛ mmɔborɔhunu.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
